Yes, a planter is a non-living item, so it can be returned within 30 days of delivery as long as it's unused and in its original packaging. At 3 weeks you're still inside that window, but the 30 days run from delivery, not purchase, so check your delivery date.

Since you're not a Leafy Plus member, a change-of-mind return costs a flat $6.95, deducted from your refund. That would leave you with $23.05 back to your original payment method, issued within 5 business days of the parcel reaching our warehouse. The return is free if the planter is faulty or was sent in error.

To start, go to "My Orders" and request the return. A prepaid label will be emailed to you, and you'll need to drop the parcel off within 7 days before it expires.

Original shipping is only refunded if the whole order is returned because of our error, so it wouldn't be included here.
